messages:
julia (support): Hey team — acme-corp is seeing intermittent 401s on API requests after they rolled out an IdP change this morning. They also reported missing audit entries for a user we deprovisioned earlier and a surprising billing spike for token calls. Repro steps below. Can security/infra weigh in?

julia (support): Repro steps from customer: 1) SSO login via SAML 2) call POST /v1/generate with tenant token 3) sometimes 401 with body: "{"error":"unauthorized","request_id":"r-7f3c9a"}". Happens ~10-15% of requests.

julia (support): They also attached an audit CSV; for deprovisioned user user@acme.com we expected deprov event but there is no corresponding audit row at 2025-06-21T10:12:xxZ. Ticket: INC-5421.

samir (security): @julia thanks. Can you paste the exact request_id(s) and the tenant id? Also did they rotate their IdP certs or change NameID format? 401 + missing audit rows feels like a provisioning/auth interplay, maybe SCIM job skipped.

julia (support): request_ids: r-7f3c9a, r-7f3c9b, r-8a4d11. tenant_id: t-ACME-42. They said IdP changed NameID to persistent from email. SCIM connectors were left as-is.

ops-bot: deploy:infra-service v2025.6.21-1143 deployed to prod (instances: infer-01..infer-04) by leo — 2025-06-21T09:58:03Z

leo (infra): looking. I pulled KMS logs around that window. There's a key rotation at 2025-06-21T09:57:50Z for cmk-44 (scheduled rotation). I see several KMS::Decrypt AccessDenied errors ~09:58:10-09:58:40Z tied to requests with those request_ids. Snippet: 

```
KMS|Decrypt|ts=2025-06-21T09:58:12Z|request_id=r-7f3c9a|error=AccessDenied|key=cmk-44|principal=svc-provisioner
KMS|Decrypt|ts=2025-06-21T09:58:25Z|request_id=r-7f3c9b|error=AccessDenied|key=cmk-44|principal=svc-provisioner
```

leo (infra): HSM unwrap audit shows PENDING_ROTATION state for the wrapping key during that window, HSM returned UNWRAP_FAILED. That would cause token validation to fail if the cached DEK couldn't be decrypted.

anna (identity): SCIM job for tenant t-ACME-42 ran at 09:55 and again at 10:05. The 09:55 run logged a user patch for user@acme.com with a nameID attribute mismatch and we marked it as skipped: 

```
scim-provisioner|ts=2025-06-21T09:55:17Z|tenant=t-ACME-42|user=user@acme.com|action=patch|status=skipped|reason=attribute_mismatch:nameID
```

anna (identity): The deprov we ran 10:12 should have produced an audit row, but our audit-export job had an error and retried; check audit-export logs for 10:12-10:20.

samir (security): Two threads then: 1) KMS rotation/HSM timing causing decrypt failures => 401s, 2) audit-export hiccup causing missing audit rows. We need to confirm whether the provisioning service account had least-privilege permissions during rotation (it needs kms:Decrypt on the new key state). Also confirm SCIM mapping change (NameID) — if IdP changed NameID format we should treat it as potential root cause for provisioning being skipped and thus stale local state.

julia (support): Customer says they didn't rotate KMS or keys on our side; they only changed IdP mapping. But if our scheduled CMK rotation overlapped their change it could amplify errors. They want an RCA + whether this impacted billing (they got billed for retries).

leo (infra): For mitigation: 1) I've requeued the audit-export job for 10:12-10:20 and started a backfill job to re-ingest missing rows. 2) I'll coordinate with KMS/HSM team to rewrap blobs that failed during PENDING_ROTATION; we can re-run decrypt attempts for affected request_ids and mark those requests as retried.

samir (security): For access control review: open a least-privilege audit for svc-provisioner (principal id: svc-prov-981). Current IAM: [kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, scim:Write, scim:Read, audit:Write]. Proposal: remove scim:Write from svc-provisioner and create a narrower service role for provisioning that only does delta patches when mapping matches. Also add a temporary escalated role for retries requiring approval.

anna (identity): On SCIM mapping: if NameID switched to persistent vs email we should update our mapping doc and add a defensive fallback — if NameID present but doesn't match email, log a warning and attempt lookup by externalId. I'll push an immediate patch to the provisioner to avoid silent skips.

julia (support): Next steps for customer: 1) We're backfilling audit rows and will share export when done. 2) infra will re-run failed decrypts and reprocess token requests where possible. 3) identity will patch provisioner to reduce skips. 4) security will run least-privilege review and propose new roles. ETA for deliverables?

leo (infra): Backfill + decrypt retry ETA ~2 hours. I'll post status updates once rewrap is complete.

anna (identity): Quick patch to provisioner rolled to canary in 5m, full rollout after smoke.

samir (security): I'll start the least-privilege review now and post recommended IAM changes by EOD. Also will check billing exposure for retries and propose a credit if impacted.

julia (support): Thanks — I'll update the customer with the plan and link to this thread. Attaching incident ticket INC-5421 and customer repro logs in the ticket. :thumbsup:
